text:
Mike L: Heads-up — saw a failed customer key import during the scheduled rotation for acct 54321. A subset of Dedicated nodes returned 5xx for unwrap operations. opening thread to triage.
Sara K: Can you paste the error logs + which pool / region? Did the rotation job report any retries?
Mike L: Logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z ERROR unwrap: kms=proxy-1 key=key-54321 err=permission_denied: principal 'svc-key-injector' not in key-access-group
2026-03-20T09:12:04Z WARN rotation: attempt=1 status=FAILED job_id=rot-987
```
Pool: eu-west-1-dedicated-a, job id rot-987. Rotation job retried twice and then moved to failed state.
Jordan R: Did we change RBAC recently? I merged a tiny keystore group refactor yesterday (PR: https://git.internal/rw/keystore/pulls/678). Might have removed the short-lived service principal binding.
Alice (ProdSec): +1 — that refactor touched the "key-access-group" mapping. @Jordan R can you confirm which principals were removed? Also we should pull the KMS audit logs before any corrective actions.
ops-bot: [alert] RotationJob rot-987 failed for acct=54321 on eu-west-1-dedicated-a — triggered at 2026-03-20T09:12:05Z
Mike L: Confirmed correlation between PR merge time (2026-03-20T08:58) and first rotation failure. HSM firmware not changed. Looks like RBAC delta caused the proxy to lose unwrap permission.
Security Oncall: Classifying as incident P2 (customer affecting, key custody boundary). Start an incident doc: https://incidents.internal/rw/3250000000. Immediate asks: 1) snapshot keystore DB + store hash, 2) export KMS/HSM audit trail for key-54321, 3) record exact RBAC diff and PR author, 4) do NOT rewrap or rotate the key without Legal/Customer consent.
Legal: Note — customer owns the key material (BYOK). Any rewrap/forced rotation might require explicit customer approval and could have compliance implications depending on contract. Engage customer contacts before taking custodial actions.
Jordan R: I can open an emergency revert PR to restore the svc-key-injector binding to key-access-group. Quick patch: 
```yaml
keystore:
  key-access-group:
    - svc-key-injector
    - svc-deployer
```
If we revert, we'll need to ensure the revert is audited and the original PR is re-reviewed.
Sara K: If we revert quickly, capture a full audit timeline BEFORE and AFTER the revert. We also need to snapshot the HSM edge logs (serial numbers + connection attempts). Important: preserve logs in read-only storage so compliance can review them.
Alice (ProdSec): Triage runbook (short):
1) Collect KMS audit export for key-54321 (last 48h) -> `kmsctl export --key key-54321 --since 48h --out /tmp/kms-export-54321.json`
2) Snapshot keystore DB -> `pg_dump -Fc keystore > /tmp/keystore-snap-3250000000.dump` and compute `sha256sum`
3) Check RBAC diff: `git show 678 --name-only` and `git diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD`
4) If revert approved: open revert PR, mark as emergency, and apply only to RBAC mapping (no key material ops)
5) Notify customer ops and Legal before any rewraps
6) After fix: run validation harness: `./scripts/keystore_e2e.sh --acct 54321 --region eu-west-1`
I'll paste these steps into the incident doc.
Mike L: I'll open the rollback PR now and capture the diffs. Creating ticket for evidence archiving.
ops-bot: [automation] PR #4321 created by mike.l: "revert: restore svc-key-injector to key-access-group" — CI queued.
Mike L: Rolling the rollback to eu-west-1-dedicated-a (canary on node subset). tagging @customer-ops for visibility. I'll monitor unwrap success rate.
Security Oncall: Also add compliance and audit channels: #compliance and #audit-review. Add note to postmortem template about BYOK custody decision points and escalation timings.
Legal: If customer requests, we should offer a joint incident call and provide redacted audit logs. Keep PII out of shared artifacts.
Mike L: Update: canary (2/6 nodes) passed unwrap after RBAC revert. Rotation job resumed and completed on the canary set. Still collecting full audit export; will attach to incident doc.
Sara K: Good. Next steps: 1) run full validation on remaining pools, 2) preserve snapshots, 3) schedule a follow-up CR to harden CI checks to prevent RBAC removal during keystore refactors.
Alice (ProdSec): Also propose adding an automated pre-merge gating test that simulates a key unwrap using a read-only ephemeral key (no customer material) to catch access-group regressions.
Mike L: Agree — I'll follow up with a ticket for the gating test and assign to eng-devex. Closing interim updates here; will post final incident report when logs processed.
Security Oncall: Thanks everyone. Keep the incident doc updated with artifacts and time stamps. We may need this for SOC2 / ISO evidence.
Mike L: Final note — rotation succeeded cluster-wide at 2026-03-20T09:43:21Z. No customer key material was modified. We'll coordinate a brief customer notification per Legal guidance.
